immutable.logoRule: Use official SVG unchanged; never ask a generator to draw the logo.

palette.ratio: 75% white or near-white, 15–20% primary blue, remaining cool neutrals

typography.iOS: System SF and system CJK fallback; Dynamic Type
typography.android: System Roboto and system CJK fallback; sp
typography.headline: 1–2 lines; Chinese 8–16 characters or English 3–7 words; one primary language per asset

composition.storyTopBottomSafeZone: 12% internal recommendation; verify target platform preview

workflow: generate text-free art with recorded prompt
overlay official SVG and editable type
review mobile readability and factual claims

mobile.icons: Lucide for Web sketches; SF Symbols on iOS and Material Symbols on Android with matching meaning
mobile.motion: 120ms press, 180ms content transition, native sheet; no perpetual decorative loops
mobile.reducedMotion: remove rotation, scale and translation; preserve state text and actions

acceptance: correct target ratio and safe area
scope: Design references and Web interaction demos; not proof of native build, VPN connection or security capabilities.
